shortDescription: Bank of Communications SSE:601328 reported on Friday a 4% rise in first-half net profit.Net profit reached 47.874 billion yuan  ($7.12 billion) in the six months ending June 30, up from 46.016 billion yuan a year earlier.($1 = 6.7201 Chinese yuan renminbi)
